generatedCommentsNodes.comment: The new implementations of `pullBlockIfNotFoundWithMessageSelector` pass the `MessageQueue mq` directly to the implementation class. However, the existing `pullBlockIfNotFound` method wraps the queue using `queueWithNamespace(mq)`. To ensure consistent namespace handling, these new methods should also use `queueWithNamespace(mq)` when calling the underlying implementation.
